note: Canonical note for a world rule, concept, faction, or custom, under `30 Canon/34 Lore/`. Machine source: `00 Meta/Templates/entity-lore.md`.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Fixed classifier — always `lore`. Set by the template; do not change it.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Text. The lore entry's canonical name. Should match the note title.

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: List of text. Other names for the concept.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Select — e.g. `world rule | concept | faction | custom`. What kind of lore this is.

fields.name: related
fields.description: List of `[[wikilinks]]` to any related canon notes (characters, locations, objects, or other lore). A loose typed relation — always wikilinks — for cross-referencing.

fields.name: first_appearance
fields.description: Text — a `[[scene note]]` link. The scene where the lore first surfaces.

fields.name: series
fields.description: Text. The series this canon belongs to.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: List. Always includes `canon/lore` — how views and Bases select lore notes.
